name: Institute Dual-Track Evidence Sensitivity Addendum
purpose: Preserve broad discovery while maintaining a separate confirmatory evidence layer. No scientifically relevant study is excluded solely because it lacks registration, preregistration, a protocol, or prospective prespecification.
applies_to: institute_search_config.json protocol_version 2.0 and later unless superseded

unrestricted_discovery.label: ALL_RELEVANT_EVIDENCE
unrestricted_discovery.inclusion_rule: Include all scientifically relevant records regardless of registration status, publication type, prospective prespecification, direction of result, or whether the analysis is exploratory, provided the source and study identity can be verified.
include: historical studies conducted before modern registration norms
use: identification of evidence that would be lost by strict filters
unrestricted_discovery.restriction: Evidence-quality problems must be labeled and appraised but do not remove the record from this track unless the source cannot be verified or is scientifically irrelevant to the question.

confirmatory_adjudication.label: HIGHER_CONFIDENCE_EVIDENCE
confirmatory_adjudication.source_pool: Derived from the same unrestricted evidence ledger; do not perform a separate search that could miss records.
promotion_criteria: source and decisive results are verifiable
design is appropriate for the claim being made
temporality is adequate for causal or predictive claims
major confounding is addressed when relevant
discovery biomarkers or subgroups have independent validation or are explicitly retained as exploratory
outcome or analysis provenance is sufficiently clear to judge selective reporting risk
confirmatory_adjudication.registration_rule: Registration or preregistration strengthens confidence and facilitates missing-evidence assessment but is not an automatic eligibility requirement. Lack of registration alone must never exclude an otherwise relevant study. For historical eras or study designs where registration was not customary, absence of registration should be treated as non-informative or only mildly informative rather than a major penalty.
downgrade_not_exclude: cross-sectional association used only for association claims
preprint with sufficient methods and verifiable data provenance

compare: effect magnitude when pooling is valid
which mechanisms or subgroups appear only in the unrestricted track
which claims become blocked or downgraded under confirmatory adjudication
delta_analysis.interpretation_rule: A signal present only in the unrestricted track is retained as a discovery signal, not discarded. It is labeled CONFIRMATION_PENDING unless contradicted by stronger evidence.
delta_analysis.restriction_sensitivity: If model preference or a central conclusion materially changes between tracks, label the conclusion RESTRICTION_SENSITIVE and identify the exact records causing the change.

prohibited_behavior: excluding a study solely because it was not registered
treating registration as proof of validity
treating lack of registration as proof of invalidity
mixing exploratory and confirmatory evidence without labeling
discarding historical evidence because modern registration standards did not exist
counting multiple publications from one parent cohort as independent replication
